home.title: Platform status
home.description: Technical foundation, users, roles and audit running. Modules are enabled per the roadmap.

login.title: Sign in
login.apiUnavailable: The API is unreachable. Please try again in a few minutes.
login.mfaHelp: Enter the 6-digit code from your authenticator app.
login.passwordChangeHelp: You are using a temporary password. Choose a new one to continue.
login.mfaSetupHelp: Your administrator account requires a second factor before continuing.
login.lede: Use your SAPExtract username and password.
login.help: Can't sign in? Contact an administrator.
login.lockoutHint: After several failed attempts, the account is locked for a while.

password.policyHint: At least 12 characters. Avoid known passwords, sequences and your username.
password.changed: Password updated. Your other sessions were closed.

mfa.intro: Add a second factor with an app such as Microsoft Authenticator or Google Authenticator.
mfa.scanQr: Scan the QR code with your authenticator app.
mfa.enterCode: Type the 6-digit code shown by the app.
mfa.qrAlt: QR code for the authenticator app

forbidden.title: No access
forbidden.body: Your role does not grant access to this screen. Ask an administrator.

notFound.title: Page not found
notFound.body: The address does not exist or was moved.

destinations.title: Destinations
destinations.description: Where extracted data is loaded: Snowflake or CSV files. Each destination is tested before it is activated.
destinations.emptyFirst: Register a Snowflake destination or a CSV folder to create pipelines.

snowflake.label: Snowflake
snowflake.description: Loads into Snowflake tables with key-pair auth: Parquet to a temporary stage, COPY and MERGE in one transaction.

csv.label: CSV files
csv.description: CSV files (optionally gzip) in an allowed server folder, published atomically with a manifest and _SUCCESS.

hints.code: Unique identifier: letters, digits and underscore (3 to 30). Cannot be changed.

validation.code: Use 3 to 30 letters, digits or underscore, starting with a letter.
validation.invalid: Check this field: it is required or out of range.

form.pemHint: Paste the PKCS#8 private key in PEM format. It is stored encrypted and never shown again.

report.title: Test result
report.outdated: Configuration or credentials changed after this test: run it again before activating.

wizard.description: Configure the destination, test it and save it. Only active destinations receive loads.
wizard.typeHelp: Choose the destination type. The next form depends on it.
wizard.noCsvRoots: The server has no CSV root folders (SX_CSV_ROOTS). Ask the administrator to configure at least one.
wizard.keyPairHelp: Generate an RSA key pair, register the public key on the Snowflake service user (ALTER USER … SET RSA_PUBLIC_KEY) and paste the private key here.

testHelp.snowflake: Checks network, authentication, context (role, warehouse, database and schema) and privileges to create tables and stages.
testHelp.csv: Checks that the folder is inside an allowed root, is writable and has free space.

wizard.testReusesCredentials: The test uses the stored credentials. To change them use “Rotate keys” on the detail page.
wizard.credentialsElsewhere: Credentials are changed from the detail page with “Rotate keys”.
wizard.activateHelp: The test passed: the destination will be available to pipelines.
wizard.activateBlocked: It can only be activated after a successful test.

rotate.title: Rotate keys of {{code}}
rotate.help: Register the new public key in Snowflake first (two can be active: RSA_PUBLIC_KEY_2). Saving tests the destination with the new key.

ddl.title: DDL preview
ddl.help: Choose an entity set from an SAP system to see the table or files that would be created in this destination. Nothing is executed.
ddl.targetHint: Table or folder: letters, digits and underscore.
ddl.targetInvalid: Use letters, digits and underscore, starting with a letter or underscore.

detail.noTest: This destination has not been tested yet.
detail.draftBanner: Draft: test the destination and activate it to use it in pipelines.
detail.inactiveBanner: Inactive destination: it receives no loads.
detail.pipelinesSoon: Pipelines arrive in iteration 6; the ones loading into this destination will be listed here.

activate.title: Activate {{code}}?
activate.message: The destination will be available to pipelines.

deactivate.title: Deactivate {{code}}?
deactivate.message: Pipelines using it cannot load until it is reactivated.

delete.title: Delete {{code}}?
delete.message: The destination is retired and its credentials destroyed. Data already loaded is not touched.
